description: An owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR takes the first header to the peer; the headers after it carry CAPABILITY.
note: As drc-padding-continues-rotation, but the request's type 8 D_PDU carries EOW 0x700, type 7, RESERVED, which this node does not recognise (C-0405, C-0421), so UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR naming type 7, EOW 0x307, is owed to 0.0.1.3 (C-0445, C-1079). At 52000 it goes in the first header placed for 0.0.1.3, the type 8 carrying the accept (C-1079, C-1260), and the 2 PADDING D_PDUs of the fill carry CAPABILITY, 0xF01 (C-0426, C-0373). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 48 bytes and 4800 ms a block; the type 8 D_PDU carrying a one-byte CAS-1 C_PDU (address size 3, C-0133) is 25 bytes, so the transmission is one block, 5550 ms, and every D_PDU in it starts in block 0: EOT ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043), and the type 8 reception window 10 (C-0350). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 draws slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The link is made when the accept has been sent, at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400, C-1100), with the timers of cas-make-called-accept.
